scenarios.title: Go to a job interview
goals: Say why you want the job
Say what pay you hope for

ai.zh: 你好，请坐。你是来应聘的吗？
ai.en: Hello, please sit down. Are you here to apply for the job?

ai.zh: 你有工作经验吗？
ai.en: Do you have work experience?

ai.zh: 很好。你为什么想来我们公司？
ai.en: Good. Why do you want to come to our company?

ai.zh: 好的，我们会通知你。你对工资有什么想法？
ai.en: Okay, we will notify you. What do you think about the pay?

ai.zh: 好的，谢谢你来面试。
ai.en: Okay, thank you for coming to the interview.

you.zh: 是的，我想应聘这个工作。
you.en: Yes, I want to apply for this job.
I have two years of experience.

you.zh: 我对这个工作很有兴趣。
you.en: I am very interested in this work.
I hope the pay is not too low.

scenarios.title: Rent a flat
goals: Say how long you want to rent
Ask when you can move in

ai.zh: 你好，我是房东。你想租这个房子吗？
ai.en: Hello, I am the landlord. Do you want to rent this flat?

ai.zh: 好的。房租一个月三千块。
ai.en: Okay. The rent is 3,000 yuan a month.

ai.zh: 可以，两千八百块怎么样？
ai.en: Okay, how about 2,800 yuan?

ai.zh: 有，床和桌子都有，还有冰箱。
ai.en: Yes, there are a bed and a table, and also a fridge.

ai.zh: 下个星期一就可以。
ai.en: You can move in next Monday.

you.en: Yes, I want to rent it for a year.
Can the rent be a little cheaper?
Okay. Is there furniture in the flat?

you.zh: 太好了，我什么时候可以搬进来？
you.en: Great, when can I move in?

scenarios.title: Send a parcel
goals: Say you want to send a parcel
Ask if it can be faster

ai.zh: 你好，你要寄什么？
ai.en: Hello, what do you want to send?

ai.zh: 请把地址写在这里。
ai.en: Please write the address here.

ai.zh: 这个有点重，三十块。
ai.en: This is a bit heavy: 30 yuan.

ai.zh: 可以，明天就能到。
ai.en: Yes, it can arrive tomorrow.

ai.zh: 你可以用手机付钱。
ai.en: You can pay with your phone.

you.en: I want to send a parcel.
Okay, I have written it.
Can it arrive a bit faster?
Okay, how do I pay?

scenarios.title: Say sorry for being late
goals: Say sorry and give a reason
Thank them and promise to be on time

ai.zh: 你怎么现在才来？我们等了你半个小时。
ai.en: Why have you only come now? We waited for you for half an hour.

ai.zh: 你为什么没有提前给我打电话？
ai.en: Why did you not call me in advance?

ai.zh: 好吧，这次我原谅你。
ai.en: All right, I forgive you this time.

ai.zh: 好，我们快点进去吧。
ai.en: Okay, let us go in quickly.

ai.zh: 现在就要开始了，快进去吧。
ai.en: It is about to begin now; hurry in.

you.zh: 对不起，路上现在堵车了。
you.en: Sorry, there is a traffic jam on the road now.

you.zh: 我的手机没电了，真抱歉。
you.en: My phone has no battery left. I am really sorry.

you.zh: 谢谢你的理解，下次我一定准时。
you.en: Thank you for understanding; next time I will certainly be on time.

you.zh: 对了，今天的活动几点开始？
you.en: By the way, what time does today's event begin?

scenarios.title: Book a table for a group
goals: Say how many people and when

ai.zh: 你好，这里是餐厅。你要订座位吗？
ai.en: Hello, this is the restaurant. Do you want to book seats?

ai.zh: 好的，几个人？什么时候来？
ai.en: Okay, how many people? When are you coming?

ai.zh: 星期六晚上很多人聚餐，七点以后才有座位。
ai.en: Many people have group meals on Saturday evenings; there are seats only after seven.

ai.zh: 可以，我们给你们打折。
ai.en: Yes, we will give you a discount.

ai.zh: 不客气，星期六见。
ai.en: You are welcome. See you on Saturday.

you.en: Yes, I want to book some seats.

you.zh: 十个人，星期六晚上六点半。
you.en: Ten people, Saturday evening at half past six.

you.zh: 那就七点吧，你们可以打折吗？
you.en: Then seven it is; can you give a discount?
Great, thank you!

scenarios.title: Ask about a visa
goals: Ask how long it will take

ai.zh: 你好，请问你想办什么？
ai.en: Hello, what do you want to do?

ai.zh: 好的。请把护照和照片给我。
ai.en: Okay. Please give me your passport and photo.

ai.zh: 你还要在表格上写好你的地址。
ai.en: You must also write your address on the form.

ai.zh: 一般一个星期。通过以后，我们会给你打电话。
ai.en: Usually one week. After it is approved, we will call you.

ai.zh: 不客气，再见。
ai.en: You are welcome. Goodbye.

you.en: I want to apply for a visa.

you.zh: 好的，这是我的护照。我还需要什么材料？
you.en: Okay, here is my passport. What other materials do I need?
Okay. How long will the visa take?
Okay, thank you very much.

scenarios.title: Talk to your coach
goals: Ask if it will be too tiring

ai.zh: 你好，我是你的教练。你想什么时候开始锻炼？
ai.en: Hello, I am your coach. When do you want to start exercising?

ai.zh: 好。你现在的体重是多少？
ai.en: Good. What is your weight now?

ai.zh: 你每天可以跑三十分钟，然后放松一下。
ai.en: You can run for thirty minutes every day and then relax a bit.

ai.zh: 不会的，运动可以让人放松。
ai.en: No, it will not; exercise can help people relax.

ai.zh: 太好了，加油！
ai.en: Great, keep it up!

you.en: I want to start this week.
My weight is 70 kilograms.

you.zh: 我工作很忙，压力很大，会不会太累？
you.en: I am busy at work and under great pressure; will it be too tiring?
Okay, I will keep at it.

scenarios.title: Cheer up a friend
goals: Tell your friend not to be nervous
Invite them out after the exam

ai.zh: 明天有考试，我很紧张。
ai.en: There is an exam tomorrow, and I am very nervous.

ai.zh: 可是我还是担心，压力很大。
ai.en: But I still worry, and the pressure is great.

ai.zh: 谢谢你的鼓励。我今天晚上应该怎么复习？
ai.en: Thank you for your encouragement. How should I review this evening?

ai.zh: 好的，我听你的。考完以后一起吃饭吧。
ai.en: Okay, I will listen to you. After the exam, let us eat together.

ai.zh: 谢谢你，我会努力的。
ai.en: Thank you, I will work hard.

you.en: Do not be nervous; you have always worked hard.

you.zh: 你要有信心，你一定能考好。
you.en: You must have confidence; you can certainly do well.

you.zh: 早点复习完，然后早点睡觉，放松一下。
you.en: Finish reviewing early, then go to bed early and relax a bit.
Great, I will invite you to a meal. Come on!

phrases.en: Could you please say it once more?

phrases.zh: 这个词在这里是什么意思？
phrases.en: What does this word mean here?

phrases.zh: 请你说得清楚一点，好吗？
phrases.en: Please speak a little more clearly, all right?

phrases.zh: 我不太了解这个词，可以解释一下吗？
phrases.en: I do not quite know this word; can you explain it?
Can you give me an example?

phrases.zh: 对不起，我没听懂，请再说一遍。
phrases.en: Sorry, I did not understand; please say it once more.
Please write it down, all right?

phrases.zh: 我想问一下，你的意思是这个吗？
phrases.en: I want to ask: is this what you mean?
